name: Mihirogi Uta
source: Uta Mihirogi is a color commentator for the inter-high and a professional mahjong player. She is also currently the vanguard for the All-Japan team. She is paired with Eri Hariu and they are the main commentator team in Saki Achiga Hen episode of side A.
